notes.title: Texturemaker: Design Your PBR Texture
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=bI4TS76AfdY;full][/previewyoutube]

I have added a new PBR custom texture designer - "TextureMaker". Apart from making original texture form sample of image data you can design your own PBR material like that in Substance Designer. Also, adding an online storage space for community based texture library and file sharing. Hope you guys build upon this. TextureWorks community.

Now, Moving on to working on another very awesome update... PBR Texture painting Anyone!! ;) 

Note: As I am progressing towards end of adding the final feature for making TextureWorks a full fledged solution when it comes to material/texture generation and painting. Hence, Expect an increment in price after next update.
